# AMZX FullExplorer

> AMZX FullExplorer is a high-performance on-chain indexer, microblock synchronizer, and database search engine built on an optimized SQLite Triples relational store for the AMZX blockchain (AMZ) by Amazonic One.

AMZX FullExplorer (`https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com`) delivers real-time transaction lookups, block height validation, address ledger balances, generator mining statistics, and high-frequency JSON API queries.

## Network & System Properties

- **Host Service**: `https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com`
- **Network Name**: AMZX Blockchain Mainnet (Amazonic One)
- **Chain ID**: A (65)
- **Ticker**: AMZ (1 AMZ = 10^8 satoshis)
- **Official Tokens**: amz1 (Asset ID: 7JuwpAgKpQDuorg5xX8AFbhRMMgrCfbwUgdktxypkYHz), AUSDTW (18 decimals)
- **Engine**: PHP 8.x + SQLite3 WAL Mode with Triples Architecture
- **Sync Protocol**: Real-time gRPC & REST polling against AMZX validation nodes (`https://nodes.amzexplorer.com/`)
- **Consensus**: Fair LPoS with Waves-NG microblocks

## Key Web Pages & Navigation

- [FullExplorer Index](https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com/): Real-time generator ranking, network statistics, and search bar.
- [Block View](https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com/b/): Direct block inspector (`/b/{height}` or `/b/{signature}`).
- [Transaction Inspector](https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com/tx/): On-chain transaction details (`/tx/{id}`).
- [Address Ledger](https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com/): Individual account activity and data storage (`/{address}`).
- [Generators & Validators](https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com/GENERATORS): Detailed leaderboard of block-producing nodes and mining reward shares.
- [Rich List & Top Balances](https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com/top): Top accounts ranked by circulating AMZ balances.
- [Protocol Activation & Features](https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com/ACTIVATION): Consensus voting status for protocol feature upgrades.

## FullExplorer API Interface

- **Endpoint**: `https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com/api`
- Supports real-time balance queries, address transactions, key-value data entries, and generator history.
